topics.title: CoreWeave's strong quarter sends AI stocks higher
topics.explanation: CoreWeave, a company that rents out AI computing power, beat revenue forecasts and raised its outlook. Its shares jumped about 26%, and the Nasdaq 100 rose about 3% as worries about an AI slowdown eased.
topics.why_it_matters: CoreWeave is seen as a test of whether AI spending is paying off, so its results move the whole 'AI trade': the group of stocks investors buy as a bet on AI.

topics.title: Congress and Nvidia's own lawyers look into Jensen Huang's alleged spy affair
topics.explanation: Lawmakers plan to call Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to answer for an alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy, and Nvidia hired the law firm Wachtell Lipton to lead an internal probe. Baird downgraded the stock over worries about Huang and AI uncertainty.
topics.why_it_matters: When a company's value is closely tied to one leader, doubts about that person can hit the stock hard. This is called key-person risk.

topics.title: Anthropic's IPO draws heavy demand
topics.explanation: Anthropic's share sale is reported to be several times oversubscribed, meaning investors asked for far more shares than are on offer, and its roadshow (meetings to pitch big investors) has begun.
topics.why_it_matters: An IPO (initial public offering) is when a private company first sells shares to the public. Strong demand can mean a higher price and shows how much investors will pay for AI companies.

topics.title: Traders bet on a Fed rate hike, pushing yields up and gold down
topics.explanation: Bond yields in Asia rose on growing expectations that the US Federal Reserve will raise interest rates, and gold fell below $4,000 an ounce as traders weighed inflation data and comments from Fed officials.
topics.why_it_matters: Higher interest rates make bonds pay more, which tends to pull money away from assets that pay no interest, like gold, and makes borrowing more expensive across the economy.

topics.title: Stocks you can trade around the clock, as tokens
topics.explanation: An affiliate of the New York Stock Exchange plans to launch 24/7 trading of 'tokenized' stocks this month, and Payward, backed by Nasdaq, launched tokenized versions of European stocks.
topics.why_it_matters: A tokenized stock is a digital token, recorded on a blockchain, that tracks a real share. It could let people trade outside normal market hours (9:30 am to 4 pm New York time).

topics.title: Meta's longtime head of infrastructure is leaving
topics.explanation: Meta's head of infrastructure, who oversees its data centers, is leaving and will be succeeded by a former Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud executive.
topics.why_it_matters: Big tech companies are spending tens of billions on AI data centers, so who runs that build-out matters to investors.
